name: watcher-loop
description: Runs a watcher command for the life of a Claude Code session and wakes the session only when the watcher reports something

command.title: Watcher command
command.description: Shell command that blocks until something happens, prints what happened and exits. Runs with sh -c in the session's working directory.

ignore.title: Ignore pattern
ignore.description: Regular expression; output that matches it opens no turn (for example TIMEOUT|ALREADY RUNNING). Leave empty to report all output.

lines.title: Lines to report
lines.description: How many of the last output lines go into the turn.
